summary.tldr: Creates a federal strategy for flood and drought forecasting, with consultations, a report to Parliament, and a later review.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of the Environment, with four other federal ministers, to develop a national strategy on flood and drought forecasting.
Requires consultations with provincial and municipal governments, Indigenous governing bodies, universities, civil society organisations and industry, including the insurance industry.
Requires the strategy to assess national coordination, new investment, modelling, new technology and the possible creation of a national forecasting service and system.
Requires a report on the strategy within two years, and a second report on its effectiveness within five years, with both reports tabled in Parliament and published online.
summary.background: The bill defines the Minister as the Minister of the Environment. It also says the strategy may include a proposal for a cooperative national hydrological and water resources forecasting service and system.
